name: Castaneda Meat Market & Taqueria
tagline: Fresh meat counter and tacos on North La Salle Street.
about: Castaneda Meat Market & Taqueria at 808 N La Salle St sells fresh meat and serves tacos.
Customers mention the homemade green salsa and the professional butchers, and one 2025 reviewer called it a hidden gem in Navasota.
address: 808 N La Salle St, Navasota, TX 77868
sources: Address, 4.5 rating from 10 Yelp reviews, review themes: https://www.mapquest.com/us/texas/castaneda-meat-market-taqueria-304174819
conflicts: No public phone number or hours were found. A SNAP retailer listing names Carniceria Castaneda Meat Market at 810 N La Salle St, next door.
